value.rationale: Open and closed triples are fundamental clustering/transitivity motifs. Distinguishing the two common null models matters mathematically: in G(n,p) their covariance is positive below an explicit density threshold, while conditioning on the total edge count forces it strictly negative at every finite nondegenerate parameter. The all-parameter exact formula and fixed-density nonzero correlation make this a substantial structural boundary rather than a mere textbook marginal moment or tiny numeric improvement.
